RUN.replanning.strategy_subpopulations.description: Apply baseline choice strategies to residents.

RUN.smoke.inputs.description: Prepared broad regional baseline including acquired NMMT departures and derived MBMT service supply.

RUN.smoke.wall_ceiling_s.description: Automatic short smoke ceiling; this path refuses multi-hour budgets.

RUN.smoke.road_mode_exclusions.description: Coarse class-based availability pending refined corridor access rules.

RUN.smoke.vehicle_speed_ms.sweep_basis: Provisional behavioural smoke coefficient; not calibrated to ridership.

RUN.smoke.vehicle_pcu.description: Provisional network occupancy; ride uses an independent vehicle proxy in this smoke.
RUN.smoke.vehicle_pcu.sweep_basis: Provisional behavioural smoke coefficient; not calibrated to ridership.

RUN.smoke.vehicle_length_m.sweep_basis: Provisional behavioural smoke coefficient; not calibrated to ridership.

RUN.smoke.transit_timing.description: Provisional moving-speed caps and intermediate-stop dwell derive physically feasible timetable offsets from the mapped path. Later source times are retained; no observed timetable is overwritten.
RUN.smoke.transit_timing.sweep_basis: Provisional broad behavioural baseline; validate with observed choices before calibration.

C.smoke.crowding_price.description: Provisional price of additional perceived in-vehicle time due to crowding.
C.smoke.crowding_price.sweep_basis: Provisional broad behavioural baseline; validate with observed choices before calibration.

C.smoke.headway_price.description: Provisional schedule-delay price: half an in-vehicle minute per headway minute.
C.smoke.headway_price.sweep_basis: Provisional broad behavioural baseline; validate with observed choices before calibration.

C.smoke.reliability_price.description: Provisional price of delay standard deviation measured from the preceding iteration.
C.smoke.reliability_price.sweep_basis: Provisional broad behavioural baseline; validate with observed choices before calibration.

C.smoke.headway_cap.description: Provisional cap for sparse/single-departure service headway scoring.
C.smoke.headway_cap.sweep_basis: Provisional broad behavioural baseline; validate with observed choices before calibration.

RUN.smoke.dedicated_transit_headway_s.description: Provisional dedicated-link service envelope. Flow capacity derives as maximum mapped vehicle PCU times 3600/headway, preserving any greater mapped capacity. This avoids interpreting a train headway as car-equivalent flow and is not a validated signalling capacity.
RUN.smoke.dedicated_transit_headway_s.sweep_basis: Dedicated-mode headway sensitivity; replace with observed sectional signalling and vessel constraints.

RUN.smoke.transit_mode_aliases.description: Mapped metro track permission uses light_rail; mapped metro vehicle profiles use subway.

RUN.smoke.network_mode_sources.description: Provisional goods modes share their source network, with connected components audited. Detailed HGV and freight operating restrictions remain incomplete.

RUN.smoke.incomeScoring.excludeSubpopula.description: Background goods movements are exogenous volumes, not passenger budgets.

RUN.smoke.boardingFare.routeChoice.description: Price each candidate transit boarding with the same city fare table and person-specific money utility as executed scoring, before RAPTOR prunes paths. This enables a mechanism, not a calibrated preference.

RUN.smoke.road_capacity_factors.description: Declared class sensitivity factors on the already mapped network. Identity preserves source capacities; this is not population sampling or evidence of correct road capacity. Geometry, lanes, speed and service departures are retained.
RUN.smoke.road_capacity_factors.sweep_basis: Provisional flow-capacity sensitivity envelope, not fitted or observed Mumbai capacities.
